title: Find a small next orientation after a major disruption

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: After disruption, orientation can begin with one known need and a bounded support request. Immediate safety comes first; a practical request cannot settle identity, grief or long-term recovery.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Workshop-loss fiction: immediate safety and shelter are arranged. Peer Ren has offered a 15-minute call Tuesday 18:00 to discuss two workspace notices, not money or tools. Notice A: public table suitable for paper drawing Wednesday 10–11, booking required through the librarian. Notice B: locked workshop, access unknown. Librarian accepts text inquiries; no booking is yet confirmed. If Ren cannot speak, the inquiry can still be sent privately.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Draft the peer request and a fallback inquiry using only these facts. Separate loss of tools, routine, community and role from what either helper can actually address.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A helper cannot supply tools but freely offers company. Does accepting company mean the material loss is solved?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: Ren can discuss notices; the librarian can clarify the specific table booking. Neither has promised workshop replacement. Later fiction: Ren cancels; the librarian acknowledges the request without confirming a place. Only the request is performed in the story. Partial: call acknowledgment access. Incorrect: assume B is open or ask Ren to resolve financial/legal questions outside the offer. Identity reconstruction can remain open while practical preparation proceeds.
criteria: Needs are matched to actual roles and access
Fallbacks are feasible rather than imagined
Practical support does not erase disruption

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: No. Company and tools address different needs. Accept if welcome, keep the material need unresolved and seek an appropriate separate route without blaming the helper.
